units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:2">Pes. VII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 75b:10">75ᵇ</cite>) <he>יִקְלוֹף את מקומו</he> (Bab. ed. <he>יְקַלֵּף</he>) let him pare off the place where it touched the wall of the stove. Ib. 3 <he>יקלוף את החיצון</he> let him pare off the surface.

<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 6:8">Tosef. Neg. VI, 8</cite> <he>היה קוֹלֵף וכ׳</he> he scraped off the sand (cement) between one stone and another; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>קָלוּף</he>; f. <cite ref="S01288"><he>קְלוּפָה</he></cite> &c.
<cite ref="Niddah 17a:11">Nidd. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>שום ק׳ … וביצה ק׳ וכ׳</he> peeled garlic, peeled onions or peeled eggs … which were let lie over night.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 3:8">Bicc. III, 8</cite> <he>ערבה ק׳</he> peeled willow twigs; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:5">Maasr. IV, 5</cite> <he>שעורים מקלף וכ׳</he>(<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>) <he>המְקלֵּף</he> (Mish. ed. <he>המקליף</he>, corr. acc.) he who husks barley-corns (to eat them before tithes are given), must husk each singly and eat; <cite ref="Beitzah 13b:9">Bets. 13ᵇ</cite>. Y. Maasr. II, 50ᵃ bot.; Y. B. Mets. VII, beg. 11ᵇ <he>שלא יְקַלֵּף</he>, v. <cite ref="M02335"><he>מִצְמֵץ</he></cite>. Lam. R. introd. (R. Yoḥ. 1); Cant. R. to VIII, 4 <he>מלאך היה יורד ומְקַלְּפוֹ</he> an angel came down and scraped the Divine Name off.
<cite ref="Sotah 35b:9">Sot. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>וקִילְּפוּ את הסיד</he> they scraped the lime off (which covered the inscription); a. e.

senses.gloss: to be peeled off. Lam. R. l. c.; Cant. R. l. c. מאליו היה נ׳ it (the Divine Name) was erased of itself.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 49b:2">Ib. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>מה חלב … קרום ונ׳ וכ׳</he> as ‘the fat that covers the inwards’ has a skin which can be peeled off, so all fat with a skin that can be peeled off (is forbidden), v. <cite ref="V00337"><he>תּוֹתָב</he></cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 10:5">Kel. X, 5</cite> <he>חבית שנִתְקַלְּפָה וכ׳</he> an earthen jug which is peeled off (crumbled away), the pitch lining standing by itself; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 7:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VII, 8</cite> [read:] <he>נתקלפה והזפת וכ׳</he>.
